basics.name: Tianyu Wu
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate, Biophysics and Quantitative Biology
basics.summary: Ph.D. candidate at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign working on AI for Biology (AI4Bio) and protein design, with a focus on automatic scientific discovery: building generative AI systems that propose scientific hypotheses and designs. Background in GPU-accelerated whole-cell modeling.

work.name: Luthey-Schulten Group, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
work.summary: Spatially resolved whole-cell simulation of baker's yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae).
highlights: Built the first 4D hybrid RDME-ODE simulations of the yeast galactose switch on the GPU-based Lattice Microbes platform, with cell geometry taken from cryo-electron tomograms.
Benchmarked the multi-GPU solver under different spatial decompositions.
Platform talk and session co-chair, Systems Biophysics, Biophysical Society Annual Meeting 2026.

work.name: Diwakar Shukla Group, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
work.position: Graduate Researcher, AI for Biology and Protein Design
work.summary: Generative AI systems that propose scientific hypotheses and designs.
highlights: Learned ranker for protein-ligand pose prediction that reaches 86.0% top-1 accuracy on PoseBusters v2.
Protein language models (ESM2) adapted with LoRA fine-tuning.
Tests of whether LLM representations and outputs can be trusted, using acceptance guards and null controls (NeurIPS 2026 XAI4Science workshop).
Methods for automatic scientific discovery: deciding which measurement separates competing mechanistic explanations of the same data.

publications.name: MetaCarto: biologically faithful automatic layout for genome-scale metabolic maps
publications.summary: T. Wu. An automatic layout framework that draws genome-scale metabolic models as curator-style pathway maps. Applied to all 108 BiGG models to produce 2,621 maps without manual rearrangement.

publications.name: Spatial heterogeneity alters the dynamics of the yeast galactose switch: Insights from 4D RDME-ODE hybrid simulations (meeting abstract)
publications.summary: T. Wu, M.-C. Spindler, A. Apsley, H. Li, Z. R. Thornburg, J. Mahamid, Z. Luthey-Schulten. Platform talk, Systems Biophysics, BPS 2026 Annual Meeting.

publications.name: Spatial Heterogeneity Alters the Dynamics of the Yeast Galactose Switch: Insights from 4D RDME-ODE Hybrid Simulations
publications.summary: T. Wu, M.-C. Spindler, E. Earnest, H. Li, Z. R. Thornburg, J. Mahamid, Z. Luthey-Schulten. The first 4D simulations of the galactose switch in a tomogram-based yeast cell.

publications.name: Visualizing Cell Structures with Minecraft
publications.summary: T. Wu, Z. R. Thornburg, K. Tan, S. Kenkel, S. A. Boppart, R. Bhargava, Z. Luthey-Schulten.

projects.name: MetaCarto
projects.summary: Automatic, deterministic layout of genome-scale metabolic models as Escher-compatible maps, with a browsable viewer for all 108 BiGG models.

projects.name: Can a virtual cell predict a pathway it has never seen switch on?
projects.summary: A pilot on 24,562 human blood cells that separates what expression data, mechanistic knowledge and a handful of stimulated cells each contribute to predicting an unseen interferon response.

projects.name: Domain Module Contract
projects.summary: A proposal for shipping domain expertise as a module that plugs into each new foundation model instead of a fork of an old one.
